newsitem.title: CHINA: Cheung Kong's new flats oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong's new flats oversubscribed.

text.p: Cheung Kong Holdings Ltd said on Monday the first batch of flats at its residential development in Shatin in the New Territories was about three times subscribed in the first two hours of registration.

It said more than 600 potential buyers registered on Monday morning for the 204 units available for sale at Vista Paradiso, a joint venture project equally owned by Cheung Kong and Concord Land Development Co Ltd.
Cheung Kong expected the subscription level to rise before registration closes on Wednesday, it said in a statement.
The units will be sold on July 26.
The first batch of flats at Vista Paradiso, which has about 2,030 residential units in Ma On Shan, would be sold at HK$6,148 per square foot, the company has said.
